names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 noiembrie, «Sfântul Ilarion Georgianul, făcătorul de minuni».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Ιλαρίων ο Ίβηρ, ο εν Θεσσαλονίκη», with the rank word left off; the page's epithets «ο Ίβηρ» — the Georgian — and «ο εν Θεσσαλονίκη» are left out of the stored form and said in the life.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 19 ноября ст. ст., «Иларион Грузинский, иеромонах», with the grade word left off; the line itself declines the forename and prints чудотворца as a separate clause, which is the `wonderworker` this folder already carries in `types`. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

birth.note: days.pravoslavie.ru: «Преподобный Иларион чудотворец родился в 816 г. в Кахетии». This folder held no year of birth; neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave one.

death.note: Unchanged, and now confirmed by a second source: days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 19 ноября ст. ст. with «(875)» and its life page says «Он мирно отошел ко Господу 19 ноября 875 г.», which is the feast day itself. The translation of the relics to Constantinople in 882 is a translation and not a death, and is in the life only.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Илариона чудотворца, Грузинского (875) (Груз.).»

feast.note: Not the same man as the corpus's Hilarion the New of Georgia, whom doxologia keeps on 14 februarie: that one is Iese Kanchaveli, born 1776 at Shorapani and died 1864, while this one is a Kakhetian of the ninth century who died in 875 at Thessalonica.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 19 noiembrie — «Sfântul Ilarion Georgianul, făcătorul de minuni»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Ιλαρίων ο Ίβηρ, ο εν Θεσσαλονίκη»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2913/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Οσιος Ιλαριων ο Ιβηρ, ο Εν Θεσσαλονικη (; - 875)», the same day and the same year of death the folder already carries from doxologia, and the same man: a ninth-century Georgian who travelled to the Holy Land, Constantinople and Bithynia, then by way of Thessalonica to Rome, and who stayed at Thessalonica and died there in 875. The folder's existing dates are not replaced; the page adds only that he built a church there in 870. No hymn on the page. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
